headline: Philippines Marks 43rd Ninoy Aquino Day with Memorial Tributes
seoTitle: Philippines Marks 43rd Ninoy Aquino Day | FMB News
seoDescription: The Philippines marked the 43rd anniversary of Ninoy Aquino's assassination on August 21, 2026, with memorial tributes and reflections on public integrity.
deck: Memorial activities marked 43 years since the assassination of former Senator Benigno 'Ninoy' Aquino Jr. on August 21, 1983.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Filipinos commemorated the 43rd anniversary of the assassination of former Senator Benigno 'Ninoy' Aquino Jr. on Friday, August 21, with wreath-laying and memorial activities honoring his life and political legacy.

A wreath-laying ceremony was held at NAIA Terminal 1, where representatives of historical and civic organizations joined the commemoration. August 21 is observed as Ninoy Aquino Day and is a special non-working day in 2026.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: Aquino was assassinated on August 21, 1983 after returning to the Philippines from exile in the United States. His killing became a defining event in the political crisis that preceded the 1986 EDSA People Power Revolution.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: The annual observance remains a national occasion for examining democratic institutions, public accountability and the historical events that shaped the restoration of constitutional government after martial law.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Historical institutions, schools and civic organizations are expected to continue educational and commemorative activities around Aquino's life, assassination and place in modern Philippine history.
